name: glass-segmented
title: Glass Segmented Control
description: A Liquid Glass segmented control: a glass track with a brighter glass thumb that springs to the new segment, stretching in the direction of travel before it settles like a drop. Press the thumb and drag it across the segments — it follows your finger, ticks as it crosses each one and snaps to the nearest on release. Native-driver motion, Reduce Motion aware, monochrome unless you give it an accent.
